fullPassage: There is no scientific basis for the term 'race'. Most humans are genetically very similar and there is so little variation amongst us that it is not possible to draw neat boundaries around people and label them as a distinct racial group. Race is an example of social construction, where social processes create something that essentially does not exist but takes on real force in people's lives. Sociologists prefer to call these processes 'racialization'. Historical evidence that race has always been an issue is hard to find. For example, in ancient Rome there were various leading figures, such as Emperor Septimius Severus (ruled C.E. 193–211), who were black. Little is said of their skin colour in accounts written at the time, because the ancient Romans did not think it made any difference. They thought more in terms of judging people as being civilized or a barbarian.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: '인종'이라는 용어에 대한 과학적 근거(basis)는 없다. 변이(variation)가 매우 적어서 뚜렷한(distinct) 인종 집단으로 분류하기 불가능하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① basis - variation - distinct = 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② bias(편견): basis(근거)와 혼동 주의, 과학적 '근거'가 원문
❌ ③ violation(위반): variation(변이)과 철자 유사하나 의미 상이
❌ ④ extinct(멸종한): distinct(뚜렷한)와 철자 유사하나 의미 상이
det.tip: basis(근거) vs bias(편견), variation(변이) vs violation(위반), distinct(뚜렷한) vs extinct(멸종한)

questions.passage: There is no scientific basis for the term 'race'. Most humans are genetically very similar and there is so little variation amongst us that it is not possible to draw neat boundaries around people and label them as a distinct racial group. Race is an example of ____, where social processes create something that essentially does not exist but takes on real force in people's lives. Sociologists prefer to call these processes 'racialization'. Historical evidence that race has always been an issue is hard to find. For example, in ancient Rome there were various leading figures, such as Emperor Septimius Severus (ruled C.E. 193–211), who were black. Little is said of their skin colour in accounts written at the time, because the ancient Romans did not think it made any difference. They thought more in terms of judging people as being civilized or a barbarian.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 인종은 ____의 한 예이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① social construction: 사회적 구성 — 사회적 과정이 존재하지 않는 것을 만든다는 뒤 문맥과 일치 ←정답
❌ ② natural selection: 자연선택 — 생물학 개념, 사회적 과정과 무관
❌ ③ cultural heritage: 문화유산 — 만들어지는 것이 아닌 전해져 내려오는 것
❌ ④ political reform: 정치 개혁 — 인종 개념 형성과 무관
det.tip: social construction(사회적 구성) = 사회적 과정을 통해 만들어진 개념/범주

det.korean: 고대 로마인들은 ____에 더 관심을 가졌다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① ranking by military achievements: 군사적 업적으로 순위를 매기는 것 — 본문에 없음
✅ ② judging people as being civilized or a barbarian: 사람들을 문명인인지 미개인인지 판단하는 것 — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ classifying by skin colour: 피부색으로 분류 — 문맥상 반대(로마인들은 피부색에 관심 없었음)
❌ ④ measuring genetic similarity: 유전적 유사성 측정 — 현대 과학 개념, 고대 로마와 무관
det.tip: 고대 로마에서는 피부색이 아닌 문명/야만 기준으로 사람을 판단했다
